title: EpiPlus: Epidemiology & Biostatistics Calculator Suite
description: EpiPlus is a free, open-source epidemiology and biostatistics calculator suite implementing formulas not already covered by OpenEpi, EpiCalc, or EpiStat: survey sampling design (Design Effect, cluster and stratified sample size), population burden indicators (DALY, PAF, age standardization), clinical and effect measures (vaccine effectiveness, NNT/NNH, SMD), statistical modeling (Poisson regression, Bayesian diagnostic test performance), and meta-analysis (fixed- and random-effects pooling with forest plots). Every calculator is validated against independent published worked examples, documented in VALIDATION.md. The app runs entirely client-side as an installable, offline-capable Progressive Web App, with no data collection.
